name: transient_conduction_plane_wall
title: Transient conduction in a plane wall with a convective boundary condition
summary: 1-D transient conduction in a plane wall of half-thickness a, initially at a uniform temperature and suddenly submitted to a convective boundary condition (h, Tinf) at t = 0: the separation-of-variables series (eigenvalues solving tan(zeta) = Bi/zeta, searched with arrays) is compared with the semi-infinite-wall (erfc) solution.

origin.notes: EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Arrays/).
